messages:
Ellen (Design): Heads-up on the empty state for Privacy Mode in Private deployments. Tooltip currently says: `Privacy mode hides logs and stores minimal metadata`; feels terse and a bit vague. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/privacy-empty
Marcus (PM): Agree. We need to be explicit about what "hides" means and where users can find more info. UX ask: keep it short but unambiguous.
Tessa (Copy): Draft options:
A) \"Privacy mode limits stored logs and metadata. Learn more.\"
B) \"Reduce stored logs and metadata. Data needed for debugging may be unavailable. Learn more.\"
C) \"Minimize data retention; some diagnostics will be unavailable. Learn more.\"
Omar (Eng): From infra side, option B is the most accurate: it signals possible missing debug data. Also callout that customer-managed KMS isn't affected.
Riley (A11y): If we use a `Learn more` link, ensure link text is descriptive for screen readers (avoid just "Learn more"). Suggested link text: `Learn how Privacy mode affects logs and diagnostics` with aria-describedby linking to the tooltip.
Ellen (Design): Visual constraint: tooltip has ~2 lines. B is long. Can we shorten B to keep one line with an expandable link or a small secondary modal?
Marcus (PM): We don't want to add a modal for this small change. How about condensed copy + tooltip detail page? Example condensed: \"Limits stored logs and metadata; debugging info may be missing.\" Link: `See details` (but Riley's point stands).
Tessa (Copy): Condensed proposal + descriptive link:
- Tooltip: \"Limits stored logs and metadata; debugging info may be missing.\"
- Link: `See details about Privacy mode and diagnostics`
Riley (A11y): Good. Also add aria-label on the tooltip trigger: `Privacy mode info` and set aria-describedby to the tooltip content id. For the link, use `aria-label="See details about Privacy mode and diagnostics"` so it reads as a full phrase.
Omar (Eng): Implementation notes: tooltip is reused across Private and Dedicated pages; keeping the short line is best for reusability. We'll implement aria attributes on the trigger and the link.
Ellen (Design): Microcopy finalize:
- Tooltip text: "Limits stored logs and metadata; debugging info may be missing."
- Link text: "See details about Privacy mode and diagnostics"
- Tooltip trigger aria-label: "Privacy mode info"
- Link aria-label: same as link text
Tessa (Copy): Tiny punctuation nit: use semicolon vs period? Semicolon reads okay. I'll push to docs/microcopy/tooltips.md with character count note.
Marcus (PM): Great. I'll mark as ready for a small PR to change the component text and add aria attributes.
Omar (Eng): I'll pick up the PR and make sure shared component update doesn't regress other uses.
